book.mygolf.guide.title: Golf Guide
book.mygolf.guide.page1:
§3Basics⛳
§6Hit the ball into the hole marked by the red flagstick using your club.
book.mygolf.guide.page2:
§3Golf Ball
§6•Right-click to place.
§6•Right-click the ball entity empty-handed or while holding ball items to retrieve it.
§6•Press shift to see its hit count.
§6•Rename the ball to claim ownership so that other players can't hit it.
book.mygolf.guide.page3:
§3Flagstick
§6•Place on dirt or grass blocks.
§6•Right-click the flagstick to toggle the light beam and illumination.
book.mygolf.guide.page4:
§3Golf Club
§6•Shift + right-click to change loft angle.
§6•Hold right-click near a ball to charge a shot.
§6•Power scaling varies by loft. Auto-random-shoot triggers if held past 3 full loops.
